concrete_streaked.source: polyhaven:concrete_wall_008 + streak/stain luminance from polyhaven:red_plaster_weathered and polyhaven:worn_mossy_plasterwall
concrete_streaked.author: Poly Haven (see credits)
concrete_streaked.note: Concrete scan multiplied by the real weathering streaks and mould stains of two other scans.

stainless_dented_greasy.source: photo 'Brushed Metal Surface' (Flickr via Openverse) + polyhaven:rusty_metal_03 (low-frequency dent relief) + ambientcg:SurfaceImperfections008 (grease)
stainless_dented_greasy.author: shaire productions + Poly Haven + ambientCG

carpet_casino.source: photo 'gawdy casino carpet' (Flickr via Openverse) + ambientcg:Carpet015 pile maps
carpet_casino.author: gonzo_vision + ambientCG (Lennart Demes)
carpet_casino.note: Real casino carpet photo: keystone-corrected, flat-fielded and mirror-tiled into a seamless symmetric repeat.

felt_casino_green.author: ambientCG (Lennart Demes)
felt_casino_green.note: Baked casino green. For other colours use the luminance of albedo x your colour.

glass_dirty.source: ambientcg:SurfaceImperfections017, SurfaceImperfections009, Smear005, Smear004 (photo-based imperfection scans)
glass_dirty.author: ambientCG (Lennart Demes)
glass_dirty.note: Dirt layer for glass. mask.jpg = dirt amount (alphaMap on an overlay, or drive roughness/transmission). Clean glass roughness ~0.04.

water_ripples_puddle.author: danisabella
water_ripples_puddle.note: Raindrop rings on a puddle; scroll/flip two copies for animated rain. Normal derived from the photo's luminance (made seamless).

water_canal_calm.source: photo 'water ripples texture 1 of 3' (Flickr via Openverse)
water_canal_calm.author: JunCTionS
water_canal_calm.note: Fine wind ripples on still water; scroll slowly, blend two scales. Normal derived from the photo's luminance (made seamless).

water_wind_chop.author: Alan Cleaver
water_wind_chop.note: Larger wave undulation; blend under water_canal_calm at a different scale. Normal derived from the photo's luminance (made seamless).

asphalt_patched.author: Poly Haven (Jenelle van Heerden, Sergej Majboroda) + ambientCG (Lennart Demes)
asphalt_patched.note: Real scanned patches/worn strips/potholes composited (wrap-around) onto the main road asphalt.

stainless_brushed.author: shaire productions
stainless_brushed.note: Real photo of scratched/brushed steel: flat-fielded, made seamless; normal/roughness derived from the photo.

galvanized_steel.author: Andrew Beeston
galvanized_steel.note: Real photo of zinc spangle: flat-fielded, made seamless; brighter crystals = smoother.

chrome.source: ambientcg:Smear005 + ambientcg:SurfaceImperfections008 (photo-based smudge scans) over chrome reflectance
chrome.author: ambientCG (Lennart Demes)
chrome.note: Chrome is a near-uniform mirror; its detail is the real scanned smudges in roughness.

plastic_rough.author: ambientCG (Lennart Demes)
plastic_rough.note: Neutral light grey: multiply by the object colour (Thai red/blue plastic chairs, basins).

brass_gold.source: ambientcg:Smear002, Smear004 (photo fingerprints) + ambientcg:SurfaceImperfections017 (photo dirt) over brass reflectance
brass_gold.author: ambientCG (Lennart Demes)

plastic_glossy.author: ambientCG (Lennart Demes)
plastic_glossy.note: Neutral light grey glossy plastic with real smudges; tint per object.
